o5_evaluation.rationale: Both windows are 3/3 clean with zero duplicates and identical control-write count. B's three-sample latency is lower, but the plan defines no materiality threshold and n=3 per arm is insufficient to establish a robust material latency advantage. Under the declared promotion rule and simplicity tie-break, do not promote B on this evidence alone.
